title: Chapter 406 Outpost
content:
Chapter 406 Outpost

After being teleported, the group did not separate.

Wang Shuo looked around and found a small town in the distance.

"Let's go and take a look!" Wang Shuo said to Zhu Dongheng.

This team was naturally led by Zhu Dongheng and Wang Shuo.

Before leaving, Zhao Bangde told Xie Xiaofeng and the other two to obey Wang Shuo's orders.

But Wang Shuo still gave enough face to these three veteran warriors.

"Let's go!"

After walking for a distance, Wang Shuo found that his feet quickly lost temperature in heavy armor, so they had to take out some cotton clothes and wear them.

Before leaving, Wang Shuo still prepared a lot of supplies.

He carried some cotton clothes and cotton shoes.

Not far away, Wang Shuo found a huge series of footprints on the snow.

A single footprint was as big as a head, which made Wang Shuo a little cautious.

It seemed that there should be wild beasts, or even monsters.

After walking for a while, a small town in front of them came into sight. Along the way, they were not attacked by wild animals.

The town was not big, with only one street.

There were some shops on both sides of the town, including a blacksmith shop for repairing weapons, a tavern, an inn and other places for people to rest and eat.

Wang Shuo led everyone into the tavern.

There was not even a sign outside the tavern, and it was very shabby.

But after walking inside, it still felt much warmer.

Inside the tavern, a few pieces of wood supported the roof, and in the hall, there were three fire pits and a counter.

Behind the counter, a little old man wearing an animal skin hat saw a large group of people coming in, and hurriedly greeted them enthusiastically: "Sir, would you like to drink?"

He used the North Sea Empire language, which Wang Shuo could understand.

"Of course."

After walking for so long in the ice and snow, his body was a little stiff, and it was just right to drink some wine to warm up.

There were two guests drinking beside the other fire pits.

They were also wrapped in thick animal skins and whispered something.

But they didn't have the aura of a general, and their faces lacked a fierce aura.

Like the old boss, their faces showed a trace of old age.

Seeing Wang Shuo and his group, they were very alert and stopped talking.

Soon, the old man used a pottery jar to fill a can of wine, brought 10 bowls, and also sent a plate of peanuts.

This place was very simple, and there was not even a decent table.

The old man, the owner of the tavern, put the wine bowl on a stone beside the fire pit and said with a smile: "Sir, please enjoy."

In order to prevent accidents, Wang Shuo asked everyone and left half of the people to not drink first.

Zhu Dongheng nodded and said: "I won't drink, you drink it!"

Wang Shuo was no longer polite, poured a bowl and tasted it.

The spicy and inferior wine flowed into the throat and burned the stomach.

A stream of heat flowed through the body, and it was instantly warmed up.

Wang Shuo came here to find out about the situation in this place.

Wang Shuo turned to look at the old man and said with a smile: "Boss, where is this place?"

"Is this your first time here, sir?" The old man walked over slowly.

Wang Shuo only noticed at this time that his legs were a little abnormal and he was a little lame.

"This place used to be a sentry post in the Great Snow Mountain, responsible for monitoring the monsters on the Great Snow Mountain, but now it is abandoned and has become a temporary resting place for the warriors who enter the Great Snow Mountain to kill the monsters."
